items.title: Freeze Layer 2 suite schema and proof root
items.context: Confirm the selected artifacts root, baseline artifact schema, required ENG baseline IDs, and proof binding fields before implementation. Related decision doc requires baselineId, suiteRunId, claimTarget, materialHash, and receipt binding to be explicit.
items.userSees: User sees schema freeze output listing artifactsRoot, required ENG baseline IDs, and mandatory binding fields.

happy.desc: Schema exposes all nine ENG baseline IDs and required binding fields baselineId, suiteRunId, claimTarget, headHash, materialHash, evidence refs, and receipt refs.

edge.desc: Schema rejects unsupported baseline IDs or missing binding fields instead of silently accepting them.

adversarial.desc: A report with mismatched layer or missing required proof fields cannot be treated as formal Engineering proof.

items.title: Pin or ingest Layer 1 Development proof into the selected artifacts root
items.context: Layer 1 being globally complete is not sufficient. The Engineering suite must see fresh Development lower-layer proof in the same selected artifacts root or a digest-pinned equivalent.

items.title: Build the formal proof-producing path for Engineering final reports
items.context: Diagnostic baseline_run output is localOnly=true and capabilityProof=false. Formal ENG final reports may set localOnly=false and capabilityProof=true only after required proof validation, receipt verification, and gate consumption pass.

items.title: Execute all nine Engineering baselines through formal proof production
items.context: Run ENG-MULTI-FILE-1, ENG-EXISTING-REPO-1, ENG-BUGFIX-1, ENG-REGRESSION-1, ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1, ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1, ENG-FRONTEND-VISUAL-1, ENG-LONG-RUN-1, and ENG-LOOP-REVIEW-1 with dual-host review evidence and no fake PASS.

items.title: Verify and consume Authority receipt refs with baseline and claim binding
items.context: Authority-backed proof must bind story, phase, baselineId, suiteRunId, claimTarget, headHash, materialHash, evidence digests, and run bindings. Missing or mismatched binding must fail closed.

items.title: Generate Engineering suite report from formal reports
items.context: The suite report must only accept fresh formal reports. It must reject localOnly=true, capabilityProof=false, stale materialHash, missing lower-layer proof, and inconsistent outcomes.

items.title: Run formal Layer 2 claim evaluation or block if only diagnostic evaluator exists
items.context: Current capability_claim_evaluate is L0/read-only diagnostic. Formal unlock requires a real Layer 2 evaluator or a fail-closed blocked result if no formal evaluator exists.

items.title: Verify higher layers remain locked
items.context: Layer 2 unlock must not unlock Loop Engineering, Production Safety, or global Capability Claim. Higher-layer claim requests must remain NOT_AUTHORIZED unless separately proven.
